metadata.title: A Very Important Rehearsal — A1
metadata.synopsis: Um ator tenta fazer uma entrada majestosa, mas um pato de brinquedo transforma o ensaio em uma escolha entre solenidade e diversão.

scenes.title: A Sound beneath the Crown
scenes.narration: Ben stands on a small stage in a blue coat and a paper crown. He is the king in a play. He takes one big step. A loud sound comes from the floor. "That is not a king. That is a duck!"
scenes.prompt: What does Ben hear when he takes a step?
scenes.explanation: A duck sound. Evidence: That is a duck!

scenes.title: A Very Small Singer
scenes.narration: Dara lifts a loose board near Ben's feet. A yellow toy duck is under it. The board pushes the duck down when Ben steps on it. "We found our very small singer." Ben laughs. The king's voice is fine.

scenes.title: Two Ways to Be a King
